_comment: Bandreject filters applied to the microphone capture, in SoX, before any
ALL OF THESE ARE PROVISIONAL. They suppress an acoustic feedback loop:
Ariana's speaker into Ariana's own microphone, set ringing by broadband
traffic noise from the street. None of it is in the room and none of it is
in the raw SoX capture -- it appears only while the speaker is driven.
The real fix is echo cancellation (bin/mic-aec, VoiceProcessingIO), which
lets the speaker stay live without a loop. When that lands, DELETE THIS
FILE rather than keeping the notches as insurance: every one of them is a
hole carved in the room's sound, and a room monitor exists to hear things.
Brackets are +/-10 Hz. Ordered by frequency.

notches.note: feedback resonance, 3082 Hz -- strongest sighting, 39.6 dB above the local spectrum
